author: Tijme Gommers
excerpt: [TL;DR] Using tools such as VirusTotal, it is possible to find leaked code signing certificates. For some, the password can be cracked, after which they can be used to sign malicious code. In this blog post I explain this process, including responsible disclosure measures.
title: Finding and utilising leaked code signing certificates

author: Tijme Gommers

author: Tijme Gommers
excerpt: [TL;DR] Using a ‘feature’ in the Solidity programming language it is possible to create smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain that look completely legit; however, everyone that sends money to the contract can never get it back due to that ‘feature’.
title: Scamming people via Ethereum smart contracts

author: Tijme Gommers
excerpt: [TL;DR] Using a mathematical model of security it is possible to calculate the position of roadblocks as (cost) efficiently as possible in case of a direct terrorist threat. Dive to the results to see the roadblock placements of Amsterdam during a critical threat level.
title: Securing Amsterdam against a direct terrorist threat

author: Tijme Gommers
excerpt: Not Your Average Web Crawler (N.Y.A.W.C) is a web application crawler for vulnerability scanning. It crawls every request in a specified scope and keeps track of the request/response data. I developed N.Y.A.W.C because I needed a good open-source Python crawler that enabled me to modify requests…
title: A web application crawler for bug bounty hunting

author: Tijme Gommers
excerpt: By abusing an insecure cryptographic storage vulnerability and a reflected server cross-site-scripting vulnerability it is possible to steal and decrypt the password from a McDonald’s user. Besides that, other personal details like the user’s name, address & contact details can be stolen too.
title: Stealing passwords from McDonald’s users

author: Tijme Gommers
excerpt: By abusing a sensitive data exposure vulnerability it is possible to steal data from a Hema user. title: Cross-site-scripting on one of the largest Dutch franchisors
